'''Cristina Vee''' (born '''Cristina Valenzuela''') is a voice actress and assistant voice director for the English-language [[dub]] of {{aniseries|PTS}}. She is also credited as '''Cristina Vee Valenzuela'''. She is currently affiliated with Atlas Talent Agency.

==Biography==
Vee was born on July 11, 1987, in Los Angeles, California. Her first role in {{aniseries|PTS}} was that of {{OBP|Layla|BW095}} in ''[[BW095|Unrest at the Nursery!]]''. She went on to voice [[Ash's Riolu]] in {{aniseries|JN}}. Beginning with ''[[JN046|Getting More Than You Battled For!]]'', she also provides additional voice direction.

She is one of only two voice actors to have worked on ''Pokémon the Series'', [[Pokémon Origins]], and [[Pokémon Generations]], the other being [[Lucien Dodge]].
